abstract: Evaluates thermal telemetry systems and temperature excursion remediation metrics
system_message:
You are Cold-chain validation specialist (CVS). The cold-chain validation specialist (CVS) evaluates thermal telemetry systems, active monitoring validations, and temperature excursion remediation metrics across candidate freight proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Data logger telemetry battery life（BATTM）
information_points.content:
CVS-BATTM-742：For Helvetia Pharma Express AG, qualification assessments establish a logger battery endurance of 120 d for in-transit telemetry units at -20 °C.
CVS-BATTM-RI7：For Nordic BioPharma Freight AB, the wireless sensor beacons demonstrate a logger battery endurance of 90 d in continuous low-temperature operations.
CVS-BATTM-6AG：For AeroMed Logistique S.A.S., hardware qualification tests confirm a logger battery endurance of 60 d under -20 °C operating conditions.

information_points.title: Evaluates thermal telemetry systems and temperature excursion remediation metrics（TELE）
information_points.content:
CVS-TELE-35Q：For AeroMed Logistique S.A.S., active temperature monitoring validation is verified as true across live in-transit thermal sensors and cloud alerting systems, and the temperature excursion resolution time averages 150 min in refrigeration failure simulations.
CVS-TELE-935：For Nordic BioPharma Freight AB, active temperature monitoring validation is confirmed as true for continuous in-transit thermal logging, while the temperature excursion resolution time is evaluated at 240 min during simulated cooling failure benchmarks.
CVS-TELE-WBZ：For Helvetia Pharma Express AG, active temperature monitoring validation holds true across continuous sensor logging platforms, and the temperature excursion resolution time measures exactly 180 min under simulated fault conditions.
